name: Patriot Beer
summary: Aggressively patriotic domestic American beer favored by rural Leonida locals, mud bogging enthusiasts, and biker gangs in Ambrosia.
description: Patriot Beer is the ubiquitous domestic brew of rural Leonida. Sponsoring events at the Thrillbilly Mud Club and plastered over local stock cars, Patriot Beer commercials parody extreme hyper-nationalistic beverage marketing. Empty cans and promotional neon signs scatter across Ambrosia trailers and roadside bars.
